leads.employmentTypeRaw: Fractional / contract / interim attorney engagements via flexible legal talent network
leads.notes: Combined 70, Grade A/B — strongest new bench relationship this run. Latitude places former in-house/Big Law attorneys as fractional GCs and contract counsel for growing companies; published case studies include a wealth-management fractional-GC placement and a securities/SEC-veteran attorney serving fintech/investment/startup clients — direct evidence they staff fund-adjacent and financial-services work. Treat like Axiom/Taylor Root bench but with a clearer fund/securities track.
